title: Why the Sun’s air gets hotter higher up
description:
Astronomers think twisting magnetic fields heat the Sun’s air. The same fields can snap and set off a flare.
NASA picture: GSFC, GSFC_20171208_Archive_e000829. NASA/Goddard/SDO, 12 Jan 2015.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Mario Cogo: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-18-an-m-class-solar-flare/. To use it, please ask the owner.
